items.title: Einspruch against Kindergeld-Festsetzung
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Musterfulda erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday) and is a written administrative act (Verwaltungsakt) sent by post, so the Bekanntgabe fiction of § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO applies (Kindergeld-Festsetzungen follow AO procedural rules, § 155 EStG). The letter itself states delivery is deemed to occur on the fourth day after posting, but the correct statutory rule is the THIRD day after posting (not the fourth as stated in the letter) - this is a discrepancy, flagged in warnings. Assuming the letter was handed to the post on its date (19.11.2026), the third day after posting is 22.11.2026, which is a Sunday. § 122 Abs. 2 AO provides that if this day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, Bekanntgabe shifts to the next working day, i.e. Monday 23.11.2026 (NW has no holiday on 23.11.2026). The one-month Einspruchsfrist then runs under § 108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (23.11.2026) is the triggering event and is not counted itself; the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026 (a Wednesday, not a NW public holiday), so no further shift is needed.

items.title: Submit new Studienbescheinigung
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie uns zum Ende des Sommersemesters eine neue Studienbescheinigung ein.
items.computation: The letter only refers to 'the end of the summer semester' without stating a concrete calendar date, and German universities' semester end dates vary (commonly 30 September, sometimes later). No specific institution's academic-calendar date is given in the letter, so the exact due date cannot be determined with confidence; it most plausibly falls around 30 September of the next calendar year but this cannot be confirmed from the letter.

warnings: The letter states that postal delivery (Bekanntgabe) is deemed to occur on the fourth day after posting; the correct statutory rule under § 122 Abs. 2 AO (which governs Kindergeld-Festsetzungen via § 155 EStG) is the third day after posting. The Einspruch deadline above was computed using the legally correct 3-day rule, not the letter's stated 4-day rule, and confidence is lowered accordingly - please verify the actual posting/receipt date if possible.
